caption: The video captures a woman seen from behind in a mirrored dance studio, wearing a black top and pink flared pants. Her masked reflection appears in the wall mirror, while a phone lies still on the pale floor near the glass. She balances on her left leg with the right foot lifted and crossed behind. Both arms are bent, hands raised near her head in a pointed finger gesture. The lifted foot lowers until her legs are crossed at the ankle, and she holds that stance. Her left arm remains bent near her head, while her right arm moves from the raised position to an extended reach toward the mirror. The hand opens into a flat palm as the arm straightens. The camera remains fixed, and the reflection repeats the same leg lowering and arm extension.
